svg.title: Adding the waves together
svg.desc: Left: top-down view of the 16 wave directions made by the controller with its default values; solid arrows are the travelling waves, dashed arrows the weaker opposite waves, length shows amplitude. Right/below: a slice of the summed surface along the wind direction.
svg.text: Script defaults: 8 waves, 60 m → 4 m long,
Dashed: same wave sent the opposite way
(40 %, Q × 0.7), so it partly stands in place.
Arrow length = amplitude. That gives 16 entries
Slice of the summed surface along the wind direction (t = 0)
Vertical scale exaggerated ×20. Same defaults as above; the scene in the videos may use different values.
